title: Senior Product Manager, Inventory Planning
posting_text:
Pinecrest supplies 900 clinics with medical consumables.

What you'll do
- Own demand forecasting and replenishment planning
- Work with clinic operations and suppliers

What we're looking for
- 6+ years of product management
- Inventory planning or replenishment software experience
- Comfort working with data science on forecasting models

Nice to have
- Healthcare supply chain experience

This role requires a background check and drug screening.
